recipes.name: Super Spicy Pea Salad
ingredients_raw: 1 large jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped

steps.text: In a medium bowl, combine peas, onion, relish, egg and jalapeno. Stir in mayonnaise and cheese. Chill for at least two hours before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Super Spicy Pea Salad
raw_recipe.description: This one is not for the kids! Super spicy and perfect for those hot summer days when you want something besides potato salad to take to the neighborhood BBQ.
raw_recipe.name: Super Spicy Pea Salad
recipeIngredient: 1 large jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine peas, onion, relish, egg and jalapeno. Stir in mayonnaise and cheese. Chill for at least two hours before serving.

review.reviewBody: I try to eat healthy & yummy, but on a budget its tough. Great just like this, but then I halved the mayo and cheese, threw in a can of tuna and put it on whole wheat. WOW! This is my new tuna salad. And I can't wait to make more variations on it!

I haven eaten a canned pea since I moved away from my parents' house when I was 19, and I wasn't about to revisit them, so I used a one-pound bag of frozed peas, thawed, instead. This didn't seem particularly spicy to us, maybe my jalapeno was abnormally mild even though I didn't take the seeds and membrane out of it. I used a combination of reduced fat mayo and fat free sour cream and did not add any cheese only to keep the weight watchers points down. I cut up a big ol' kosher dill pickle instead of using relish, and I hesitated about putting in the egg, but compromised and used two hard boiled egg whites (I fed the yolks to the cats). We loved the combination of flavors, but next time I'll make sure my jalapeno has some punch. Thanks so much for the post, Shunpr!
I omitted the egg and added about 1 1/2 tsp sugar but followed the rest of the recipe. Tasted great! The chilling process is very necessary to make the flavors go through and reduce the wateriness.

Great Salad!! Not being a fan of pickle relish, the second time I made this I omitted that and the egg (although the egg was tasty in it). I added some chopped red bell pepper as another reviewer suggested and, wanting to cut down on the fat, eliminated the cheese. Instead, i made a dressing of 1/2 mayo and 1/2 fat free sour cream and added some chili powder, chipotle hot sauce and just a dab of dijon mustard. Next time I may put the egg back in or add some black beans to it, but it was delish! Thanks for such a versatile recipe!
This is an easy recipe to prepare and very tasty. I made the dish a second time and used petite frozen peas. We thought it had a fresher taste and was much better than using canned peas.

Yum! I used frozen peas, thawed. I needed low fat so I left out the cheese and egg and used only 1 Tbs. of mayo with 2 Tbs. of plain yogurt, seasoned with a little Old Bay. Threw in a can of tuna too.
Loved this!! I used thawed, frozen petite peas instead of the canned - very fresh and I'll definitely make this again!! :)
Loved it. - Had no relish so chopped 2T capers to add. - Substituted a 1 lb bag of frozen peas for the canned. - Had no pepper jack so used finely shredded mexican blend.
I'd use regular onion not red
This was pretty good...not spicy at all though, I even doubled the Jalapeno and it still was not spicy. However it is a very nice recipe.

I’m revising my review that I posted earlier today. We had this for lunch, it had not yet totally chilled down, and it was watery. After sitting in the fridge for probably 5 hours, it had totally firmed up, and tasted a heck of a lot better. Most likely, still won’t make it again, but in all fairness, it’s better than how I initially reviewed & rated it. When the recipe author says it needs to chill for 2 hours (at least), it REALLY does.
A serious crowd-pleaser! Has that 'vintage charm' but tastes surprisingly new.

I really love this. I wanted to make for my lunches so I added a can of chicken. I left out the onion and used red pepper. I used frozen peas and that worked great. I also used cheddar cheese. Can do just about anything to make it your own. A really great recipe.
I didn't have time to chill it. It was very yummy! I'll try the leftovers chilled.
Loved it! I left out the egg & pickle and added an extra jalapeno, sunflower kernels & celery.
I have made this several times and it always gets eaten up. Its great on a hot day.Thanks for the recipe!
